output.question: What is Bumble's IPO date?
output.answer: Bumble Inc. went public on February 11, 2021, when its Class A shares started trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker BMBL. The IPO was priced the evening before, on February 10, 2021: 50,000,000 shares at $43.00 each, about $2.2 billion. The offering closed on February 16, 2021. The underwriters bought all 7,500,000 extra shares in their option, so the total came to 57,500,000 shares, about $2.5 billion.

key_facts.fact: The IPO was priced on Feb 10, 2021: 50,000,000 Class A shares at $43.00 per share.
Shares were expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker BMBL on Feb 11, 2021.
The IPO closed on Feb 16, 2021. The total was 57,500,000 shares at $43.00, including the underwriters' full option of 7,500,000 extra shares.

passages.quote: 50,000,000 shares of its Class A common stock at a price to the public of $43.00 per share
expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Select Market on February 11, 2021 under the symbol “BMBL”
has closed its initial public offering of 57,500,000 shares of its Class A common stock

caveats: The 'IPO date' can mean three different days: Feb 10, 2021 (pricing), Feb 11, 2021 (first day of trading) or Feb 16, 2021 (closing). Most people mean the first trading day, Feb 11.

The pricing release says trading was 'expected' to start on Feb 11, 2021. I didn't open a separate source confirming the actual first trade, but news coverage in the search results says trading began that day.
